newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares rise after U.S. jobless data.
newsitem.headline: French shares rise after U.S. jobless data.

text.p: French shares extended their gains after the U.S. jobless data were published, showing a less than expected rise in payrolls data while the unemployment rate fell.
At 1233 GMT, the CAC-40 index was up 0.74 percent or 19.50 points at 2658.96. It had been up 0.48 percent before the data.

The lower than expected rate of job creation dispelled fears the economy was growing too fast and needed reigning in by a Federal Reserve rate hike. May CAC-40 futures were up 0.69 percent at 2641.0. Volume was a light 2.6 billion francs due to extended holidays after May Day.
